rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when dismissing rhetoric as meaningless talk.

example.english: All that rhetoric you're spouting is just to avoid responsibility.
example.traditional: 你講咁多廢話，都係想推卸責任啫。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 gam3 do1 fai3 waa2 dou1 hai6 soeng2 teoi1 se3 zaak3 jam6 ze1

rows.note: Use this when the rhetoric is flowery or manipulative and is meant to impress rather than simply being empty.

example.english: Don't let his flowery rhetoric fool you; he never intended to help you.
example.traditional: 唔好畀佢啲花言巧語呃到，佢根本冇打算幫你。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 di1 faa1 jin4 haau2 jyu5 ngaak1 dou3 keoi5 gan1 bun2 mou5 daa2 syun3 bong1 nei5

rows.note: Use this for rhetoric as the art or technique of persuasive language, especially in formal or academic contexts.

example.english: This paper analyzes how the speaker uses rhetoric to persuade the audience.
example.traditional: 呢篇論文分析咗演講者點樣運用修辭去說服聽眾。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin1 leon6 man4 fan1 sik1 zo2 jin2 gong2 ze2 dim2 joeng2 wan6 jung6 sau1 ci4 heoi3 seoi3 fuk6 ting1 zung3
